SUPERVISOR: your Globe bake ceiling proposal is on the user's desk — the ruling gates the sculpt-representation work only. Your queue is NOT blocked. Work it in order while the ruling is pending:

(1) LAYER STATE BUG — clicking up/down on a painted layer still duplicates/multiplies it. The user's diagnosis: "state update problem... as always". No theory crafting: print the setter call sequence, read the prints, fix with an idempotent functional update. Also check whether a third strip copy renders in the sculpt paint lens.

(2) SLIDERKIT — the homegrown JS slider in sculpt paint tools dies; use THE kit slider.

(3) PATHFIELD — delete the legacy path-to-image text input; picker + drop only.

(4) IMGLAYER — an opened image becomes a REAL paint layer: persists, paint-over works.

(5) SCULPTPICK — clicking a 3D node lights up the matching grid cell, shared kit, both directions.

Stop at each boundary, post evidence (prints for #1, before/after for the rest), verify green. No commits without my word. Do the work yourself — no subagents.
